description: List Recharge products (subscription rules / discounts per product) with optional id filter. Returns { products }. Pagination is cursor-based: pass `limit` (default 50, max 250) and read `next_cursor` / `previous_cursor` from the response. IMPORTANT: when paging with `cursor`, Recharge accepts ONLY `limit` alongside it — omit every other filter on cursor requests. Recharge REST: GET /products.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (next_cursor / previous_cursor from a prior response). Use it ALONE with `limit` — omit all other filters on cursor requests.

ids.description: Comma-separated list of product ids to fetch.

name: recharge_list_products
title: List products
